releaseNotes:
• Added ✕ (Clear/Stop) and 🔄 (Reload) buttons to the browser search bar
• Unified cross-app WebApp backend: Shared Google login (SSO), third-party cookies & OAuth popup support
• Completely hidden, device-local SQLite browsing history (orbis_browser_history.db)
• Automatic sidebar edge handle auto-restart after in-app updates
